Experience the Best of Cliff House Lodge & Hot Tub Cottages
Our cozy bed and breakfast offers uniquely decorated rooms for relaxation. Cliff House Lodge now partners with
Tap On The Rocks , just across Bear Creek Road. Guests receive breakfast tokens at check-in, redeemable at Tap On The Rocks (just across Bear Creek Road) until 11 AM. No advance ordering needed.
8 cottages surround the original 1873 Cliff House. Six have a private hot tub on enclosed patios, two have an in-room jetted bathtub, and Camelot has both.

ABOUT US
From 1873 Family Home to Historic Red Rocks Retreat
Built in 1873 by town founder George Morrison using local quarry stone, this historic estate evolved from a renowned 1890s boarding house into a beloved 1940s cottage resort.
Today, the
Cliff House Lodge continues its 150-year legacy as a premier destination for Red Rocks concert-goers and winter travelers seeking themed hot tub suites and our breakfast with Tap On The Rocks.
The Cliff House Lodge is Steeped in Colorado History
In 1873, town founder & stone mason, George Morrison, built his family home using material from his local quarry. Upon Morrison's death in 1895, John Swanson purchased and officially named it the Cliff House Lodge, after the Morrison Cliffs, the rock formations that overlook the estate. He made the lodge a boarding house renowned for its fine food, great rooms, and charming garden, complete with a bandstand that hosted popular Sunday concerts. Charles Ostreen acquired the lodge in 1932, and further developed the room and board. By the 1940s, all of the surrounding cottages were built, extending accommodations to frequent travelers. Peggy Hahn became proprietor in 1976, she turned the cottages into shops & by the 1980s revised them into hot tub themed rooms. In 2006 Odell Frasier Bullington purchased and continues to grow the legacy of this special bed & breakfast. Cliff House Lodge is a prime destination during summer concert season at Red Rocks Amphitheatre and a beloved winter haven for relaxing hot tub soaking.
Your Gateway to Colorado's "Off the Beaten Path" Charm
Escape the constraints of traditional hotels at
Cliff House Lodge , a laid-back, eclectic retreat where themed cottages offer a personalized, unpretentious experience. Located in the heart of historic Morrison, you are one mile from
Red Rocks Amphitheatre and the gateway to Bear Creek Canyon, leading to Evergreen and the Arapahoe National Forest. Whether you're here for a legendary concert, a scenic mountain drive, or an incomparable day of hiking, our lodge provides a uniquely "undiscovered" home base for your Colorado adventure.
Odell Bullington
Owner & Gem Dealer
Odell has owned the Cliff House Lodge since 2006. On his way to see a concert at Red Rocks Amphitheatre, he saw a sign that read "Hot Tub Cottages" and was immediately drawn to the energy of the Cliff House. Hailing from North Carolina, Odell has had a great interest in gems and minerals, art, and spirituality for many years.
